Thanks for the ping, Hannah. Reviewed the attachments. A couple of practical notes from finance: 

- For Canadian vendors providing a W-8BEN-E, we require:
  * A completed W-8BEN-E with the foreign tax identifying number (Canada BN) in Part I if no US TIN.
  * Proof of legal name matching (corporate registry screenshot is acceptable if it clearly shows the legal entity name and the BN).
  * Evidence of signatory authority (board resolution or officer title on the registry is fine if the signer is listed).

- Notarization: not required as a first step for Canadian corporate vendors unless there are red flags (e.g., mismatch, sanction screening hits, or high-risk jurisdiction).

Operationally we can issue a conditional PO with the status "Pending Tax Evidence" for onboarding expense up to $10,000. Conditions: vendor must complete e-signature on the W-8 and provide bank details before payment. If after 30 days final evidence is not received, the PO will be put on hold.

I've created a short checklist/e-sign packet for Oliver to use. Oliver — please complete the DocuSign envelope here: https://app.docusign.com/Envelope12345. Once you finish, reply-all and I will move to issue PO.

Attaching: procurement-checklist.pdf (contains finance acceptance criteria).

- Sean
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

Note: if vendor intends to claim treaty benefits in future, we will require a US TIN and additional substantiation.
